narrative.northStar: Aura — an atmosphere, not a fill
narrative.overview: This world replaced the previous 'Two Chapters' system (flat wine canvas + paper trust sections) in full — pinned by the user from a supplied reference implementation (aura-landingSample.html), not derived from a discovery round. The default surface is a near-black ink canvas, never a flat color field: depth comes from layered oxblood radial-gradient glow fixed behind the whole scroll, muted antique-gold accents, and frosted glass content surfaces floating above it. Geometry is fully rounded — pills for every button and chip, 22-34px radii for cards and panels — the opposite of the previous world's near-sharp language, and that reversal is deliberate. One constant survives the replacement: RAL 3004 (#640211), the real physical-store oxblood, remains the base of the color ramp. Business facts stay exactly as confirmed in PRODUCT.md — this is a visual-world change, not a positioning change.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with a fixed, layered oxblood-glow atmosphere behind the entire scroll — never a flat color fill.
Frosted glass is the default elevated-surface material, not a flat card fill.
Full rounded geometry: pills for every button/chip, 22-34px radii for cards/panels. No sharp corners anywhere.
Eyebrow pills and one-word gold gradient-shimmer text are back, used per-section on Persuade-mode surfaces.
One motion signature (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1)) across every transition, at one of three named durations.

rules.name: The Atmosphere-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Oxblood never owns a flat full-bleed background. It appears as radial-gradient glow, gradient button fill, or elevated-surface tint — always graduated, never flat.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold marks exactly one thing per view: the primary action or the price. Section labels use the dedicated eyebrow pill treatment, not bare gold text.

rules.name: The One Motion Signature Rule
rules.body: Every transition uses cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) at one of three named durations (150/220/300ms) — never a hardcoded per-component duration/ease pair.

rules.name: The Full Rounding Rule
rules.body: rounded-full for every interactive pill, 22px+ for cards. A 0-4px radius appearing anywhere is a regression to the retired sharp-corner world.

rules.name: The Mode-Appropriate Device Rule
rules.body: Eyebrow pills, gradient text, and floating glass stat cards are Persuade-mode devices (home page). Operate-mode surfaces (shop, partners) get the palette and glass material, not the full marketing device set.

dos: Do treat oxblood as atmosphere (gradient glow, gradient button fill) — never as a flat full-bleed background fill.
Do use .glass for elevated content surfaces by default.
Do round everything — rounded-full for pills, 22px+ for cards.
Do use the eyebrow pill above Persuade-mode section headings, but skip it on Operate-mode surfaces.
Do reserve the gold gradient-shimmer for exactly one word per heading.
donts: Don't reintroduce the .light/paper chapter, HeaderChapterWatcher, or data-chapter attributes — deliberately deleted.
Don't hardcode a per-component duration/ease pair.
Don't use champagne/wine/paper/ink-dark class names — renamed to gold/oxblood/ink/foreground.
Don't apply the full Persuade-mode device set to Operate-mode utility surfaces.
Don't state unconfirmed facts from the reference sample as real (its address, '12 years' claim, or fabricated stats) — PRODUCT.md is the only source of truth.
